tips.text: Claim it every year even if you own it; sell the extra copy and keep the free slot.
Use public matchmaking if the alert mission is awkward solo; the alerts are low level and veterans carry newcomers.
Ask a clanmate or public squad to host if the alert is on a planet you have not unlocked.
Expect a full 10 waves if the alert is a Defense; it does not get the shorter count.
Search Dex in the Arsenal if it seems missing; it arrives at rank 0 and hides in a long list.
Nobody calls the alert hard; the only regret is missing the week and waiting a year.
